scope: PostgreSQL reservation and atomic settlement candidate; no authenticated HTTP or broker integration
checks: identical retry has one persistent reservation
restart preserves reservation and retry identity
matcher cannot settle its own reservation
concurrent duplicate settlement changes trade position and order exactly once
settled retry after restart has no duplicate effect
rollback removes receipt trade position and order effects together
remaining authorized quantity settles to FILLED
limitations: Not integrated with matcher, trade service, NATS or processor
Stored authority is trusted application metadata, not independently verified by this ledger
SQL receipts deduplicate candidate settlement only; deployed Java processor remains unchanged
No broker event outbox or HTTP authentication integration; no end-to-end delivery guarantee
